blocks.text: The two-year Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme is affiliated to Andhra University and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), a statutory body under the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), New Delhi. The programme offers a single specialisation in Marketing Management, Financial Management, and Human Resource Management. To integrate core business fundamentals with essential specialised skills, the department provides add-on courses with a particular focus on soft skills and communication skills. These activities support dynamic learning, equipping students to navigate the evolving business landscape. Students are cultivated to enhance their leadership abilities, decision-making capabilities, strategic and analytical acumen, social and interpersonal skills, global outlook, creativity, and innovation.
Student Intake: 132 (96 through convener quota and 36 through management quota)
Admission Criteria: A graduate in any discipline, qualifying through APICET, the State Integrated Common Entrance Test
MBA graduates have a broad range of career options, enabling them to pursue roles across manufacturing and service sectors.
To sustain a learning environment for the holistic development of students and cultivate innovative and ethical leaders to bring positive changes in business and society.
To enhance the quality and employability of students in dynamic, global and technological environment by delivering superior and value-added inputs.

Each curricular subject is allocated four sessions per week during a semester. In addition to the conventional blackboard and regular classroom setup, teaching is enhanced with the use of LCD projectors and audiovisual equipment in seminar halls. Learner-centric methods, such as case studies, role plays, quizzes, presentations, assignments, mini-projects, discussions, and debates, are prioritised. Workshops, seminars, and field visits play a major role in the learning process.

A well-equipped computer lab with internet access is available to help students utilise information technology for their studies and familiarise themselves with online examination systems for various recruitment processes. The subjects and delivery mechanisms are periodically updated to align with market needs. Active student participation through teamwork, mentorship, and group projects provides an added advantage to their educational experience. Counselling sessions are also provided to support students academically and personally.

Research is the backbone of an academic institution. The Research Centre aims to achieve world-class excellence in research that addresses critical issues in the business realm, both in India and internationally. In 2014, Andhra University recognised this department as one of its research centres for admissions to M. Phil. and Ph. D. programmes in Management Studies, under both full-time and part-time schemes (Office Order AUCST/SG(3)/Recognition of Res. Centre/2014 dated 23.07.2014).

The Management Club operates as an "of the students, by the students, for the students" entity, allowing students to develop skills in organising and managing professional events. It serves as a platform for the expression of a variety of skills, including artistic, literary, and managerial. Activities of the club include organising guest lectures, paper presentations, role plays, debates, quizzes, cultural programmes, sports events, and various competitions, such as Ad-Mad and Brand War. These activities encourage students to manage responsibilities independently while enhancing their professional development.

The Information Technology sector is one of the fastest-growing industries worldwide. The Master of Computer Application (MCA) programme is designed to provide comprehensive knowledge, balancing both theoretical and practical aspects, with a focus on software and hardware. With an emphasis on Fundamentals of Computing and Application Development, the curriculum includes the latest programming languages and tools to equip students for developing efficient applications.

Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College is a leading choice for graduates with a mathematics background at the intermediate level to pursue this professional course. The MCA programme is affiliated to Andhra University and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), under the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), New Delhi. With over 25 years of expertise, the department boasts of state-of-the-art infrastructure, including spacious classrooms, laboratories, and both physical and digital libraries. Alongside conventional teaching methods, smart classes with ICT facilities are conducted in seminar halls designated for the course. Students receive hands-on practical exposure in well-equipped laboratories, complementing their theoretical learning. The curriculum is further enriched through orientation on the latest industry developments and trends.
Student Intake: 132 (84 through convener quota, 36 through management quota and 12 through EWS)

Admission Criteria: Any science graduate with Mathematics at the intermediate level and a qualifying rank in APICET (the state-wide entrance exam conducted by APSCHE). Candidates must have an aggregate score of 50% (45% for reserved categories - SC, ST, and BC).

Programme Pattern: 4 semesters, each comprising 5 theory papers and 2 practical papers (Lab sessions). The 4th semester includes a viva voce examination in addition to theory papers. Assessment is based on 30% internal and 70% external evaluation.

MCA graduates have diverse career opportunities across IT and related sectors, including software development, system analysis, project management, and emerging tech roles. They can pursue careers in both private and public sectors, academia, or entrepreneurship.
We envisage being the most sought-after department in Computer Science education and the choicest place for employers with a global presence.

Educate students from varied cultural, Socioeconomic backgrounds using the right mix of teaching and industry interface, bringing them all to a level playing field to enable each one to succeed in their technology career.

The curriculum, prescribed by Andhra University, offers robust theoretical and practical knowledge in Computer Science. Beyond regular lab sessions, students have access to three dedicated computer laboratories. To enhance core knowledge with specialised technical skills, the department provides additional courses and activities such as Communication Skills, Soft Skills, Analytical Skills, online tests, seminars, guest lectures, and assignments. These initiatives ensure students are prepared for the evolving technological landscape. The department also runs structured add-on programmes to inform students about emerging market trends.

Modern teaching methods are adopted to cultivate computational and algorithmic thinking, allowing students to construct and evaluate various programs and solutions, thereby fostering creative thinking among advanced learners. Knowledge is reinforced through a variety of learning approaches, promoting conceptual understanding. Students are also encouraged to enrol in high-end NPTEL courses, with guidance and support provided to help them achieve certification.

Established in 1994, the Department of Computer Science has continually enhanced its competence, becoming a preferred destination for M. Sc. Computer aspirants from across Andhra Pradesh. The department currently admits 48 students into this programme, with 40 seats filled through APPGCET counselling and 8 through management quota, following APSCHE guidelines. The department’s primary objective is to develop skilled IT professionals aligned with global industry demands by delivering a comprehensive and industry-focused curriculum.
Student Intake: 48 (40 under convener quota and 8 under management quota)
Admission Criteria: Any science graduate with Mathematics at least at the intermediate level and a qualifying rank in APPGCET (Andhra University Common Entrance Test)

The programme aims to develop global competencies and prepare students as responsible contributors to the economy. Through skill development and add-on programmes, students are equipped for diverse business environments, with career opportunities in sectors like NSTL, government, software, banking, and IT.
We envisage being the most sought-after department in Computer Science education and the choicest place for employers with a global presence .

Educate students from varied cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds using the right mix of teaching and industry interface, bringing them all to a level playing field to enable each one to succeed in their technology career.

The M. Sc. programme in Computers is conducted in line with Andhra University's norms and guidelines. Over the years, the department has refined its pedagogy and subject delivery. In addition to the standard curriculum, the department provides supplementary knowledge through guest lectures, seminars, and workshops, encouraging students to participate in inter-institutional events. The evolving needs of the industry are met through add-on programmes that bridge the gap between academic learning and required skills.

The department is equipped with modern computer, digital electronics, and data communication laboratories, ensuring the practical application of theoretical concepts. A dedicated seminar hall with an LCD projector and audio system facilitates seminars and guest lectures. The library houses relevant books, journals, and periodicals, with a 100 Mbps internet connection available for students.

As IT is a core focus, the Department of Computer Science actively promotes the use of technology within the college, developing software to automate manual processes and training staff in technology utilisation. Initiatives include:
Online Student Examination System: Enables objective examinations within the campus, used during on-campus recruitment.
Online Student Feedback System: Assists the IQAC in collecting online feedback from students on faculty, infrastructure, and facilities, enhancing efficiency.
Student Fee Tracking System: Automates and tracks fee payments, streamlining financial processes for the administrative department.

The department extensively utilises audio and video technology for teaching, with both faculty and students making full use of the Internet and digital library resources. Committed to sustainability, the department aims to make all operational processes paperless in the future.

The MSc Mathematics is a two-year postgraduate programme, divided into four semesters, with an intake of 30 students. It was the first postgraduate course introduced in the college in the academic year 1994-1995 under the leadership of Prof. P. V. Krishnaiah, former Professor of Mathematics at Andhra University.

The programme offers extensive resources for learners to explore research opportunities in areas such as Geometry, Number Theory, Differential Equations, Calculus, and Algebra. The study of Mathematics fosters reasoning, creativity, abstract thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication skills, which are essential in various aspects of society. The department provides a dynamic environment for professional development and research activities. A competitive curriculum, quality student intake, and consistently high pass rates are the strengths of the department.
Student Intake: 40 (32 through convener quota and 8 through management quota)
Admission Criteria: Any science graduate with Mathematics as a core subject and a qualifying rank in APPGCET (Andhra Pradesh Postgraduate Common Entrance Test)

Programme Pattern: 4 semesters, each with 5 theory papers. The 4th semester includes a viva voce examination and project submission. Students must complete a two-credit MOOC course in the 3rd and 4th semesters. Assessment comprises 20% internal and 80% external evaluation.

The M. Sc. Mathematics programme opens a broad range of opportunities across sectors such as Engineering, Computer Science, Pharmaceuticals, Industry, Oil and Energy, Banking, Finance, Insurance, Research Centres, and Education. Graduates can pursue diverse career paths in both private and public sectors.
Private Sector: Market research firms, pharmaceutical companies, R&D firms, engineering companies, economic research organisations, social research institutes, and educational institutions.

Public Sector: Roles such as Quantitative Risk Analyst, Equity Quantitative Analyst, Director of Statistical Programming, Interest Rate Trading Strategist, Quantitative Developer, Treasury Management Specialist, and educational roles in public institutions.
To serve the student community by imparting knowledge in Mathematics and contribute to the betterment of the society.
To facilitate smooth and qualitative conduct of teaching and learning activities in Mathematics.
To ensure academic environment for the growth of teachers and students.

The teaching-learning process encompasses participation in ongoing research, seminars, workshops, guest lectures, peer reviews, and presentations from scholars and industry experts, enhancing the classroom experience.
In addition to the central library, the departmental library houses a range of internationally recognised books, including those sponsored by the National Board of Higher Mathematics (NBHM).
Mathematics Day is celebrated annually on 22nd December in honour of the birth anniversary of the renowned mathematician, Srinivasa Ramanujan.

The PG Department of Biochemistry, affiliated to Andhra University, was established in 2002. Biochemistry, a discipline integrating principles of both Biology and Chemistry, examines the chemical and physicochemical processes that occur within living organisms. Serving as the foundation for understanding all biological processes, biochemistry explores the causes of various diseases in humans, animals, and plants. Professionals in this field contribute to the development of medicines, research into diseases, and the formulation of preventive measures to safeguard against health issues.
Student Intake: 39 (33 through the convener quota and 6 through the management quota)
Admission Criteria: Open to science graduates with a qualifying rank in APPGCET

Programme pattern: The Master of Science in Biotechnology is a two-year full-time programme, affiliated with Andhra University, spread across four semesters. It comprises 14 theory papers, 7 practical papers, a project, and a seminar. Each semester is allotted 24 credits, with a total student intake of 39 annually – 33 through the Andhra University counselling process and 6 through the management quota.

Upon completing the programme, students gain knowledge in key areas such as Immunology, Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics, Clinical Biochemistry, and Enzymology. Graduates are equipped to pursue careers in the healthcare sector, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology, food, water, and agricultural industries. Additionally, opportunities for research and advanced studies in biochemistry are available for further academic growth.
To provide expertise in the discipline of biochemistry and develop scientific temper.
To create a stimulating and supportive environment to our students and to provide ample opportunities for professional and personal growth.

The Department of Biochemistry adopts an interactive, research-focused pedagogy combining theoretical knowledge with practical training through hands-on laboratory work, problem-based learning, and research projects. Industry integration is achieved via guest lectures, industrial visits, and bioinformatics training, while technology-enhanced resources and collaborative activities promote active learning. Continuous assessments and a focus on ethical practice and soft skills ensure well-rounded development, preparing students for diverse careers in healthcare, biotechnology, and research.
Laboratories: Two fully equipped laboratories with essential equipment, including an orbital shaker, UV-visible spectrophotometer, cooling centrifuge, deep freezer, and laminar airflow systems.
Classrooms: Two spacious classrooms that overlook the campus’s basketball court and green surroundings.
Library: A well-stocked library housing a wide range of books across all PG courses, offering ample seating for students.
Computer Lab: A dedicated computer lab with up-to-date technology and internet access.

Seminar Hall: A seminar hall on the first floor equipped with modern audio-visual technology, LCD projectors, and comfortable seating arrangements, used for digital classes, seminars, workshops, and more.

Guest Lectures: The department frequently organises lectures by distinguished professionals from both academia and industry. Students are also encouraged to present on biochemistry topics beyond the curriculum in seminars.
Research Guidance: Faculty members provide support and mentorship to students for their project work and dissertations.
Industrial Visits: Regular industrial visits are arranged to offer practical exposure and insights into industry operations related to biochemistry.

The Department of Biotechnology, established in 2008 and affiliated to Andhra University, offers premier education in a field that holds immense potential to benefit humankind by transforming intellectual enterprises globally. Following the model of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) established by the Indian Government in 1986, the department excels in nurturing students’ passion for bioscience, encouraging them to explore, innovate, and excel in the pursuit of knowledge.
Student Intake: 39 (33 convener quota, 6 management quota)
Admission Criteria: Any science graduate with a qualifying rank in APPGCET (Andhra Pradesh Postgraduate Common Entrance Test)
Programme Pattern: The programme spans two years, divided into four semesters, and includes 14 theory papers, 7 practicals, a project, and a seminar. Each semester carries 24 credits.

This specialised programme provides students with an edge over other life sciences courses, equipping them with skills in diverse biosciences disciplines. With practical exposure to advanced technologies, such as healthcare diagnostics, real-time PCR, molecular diagnosis, animal tissue culture, and plant micropropagation, graduates have a broad range of career opportunities. These include roles in bioinformatics, genomics, nanotechnology, biosensors, veterinary research, agriculture, aquaculture, pharmaceuticals, pollution control, stem cell banking, and in vitro fertilisation.
Molecular diagnostic labs – e.g., Bharat Biotech
Plant tissue culture and agricultural research
IVF centres and stem cell banks
Life science product development and marketing
To attain new heights in Biotechnology research, shaping it as a career, making subject a precision tool to create wealth and health for future generations.

To make the students realize, Biotechnology as one of the greatest intellectual enterprises, by providing an impetus to fulfil the potential of understanding life processes, to attain professional competency.

The department motivates students to excel academically and in co-curricular activities, supported by a highly qualified, dedicated, and experienced faculty. The emphasis is on developing both subject knowledge and additional skills in domain-specific areas .

To provide in-depth knowledge in key areas of biology, with special focus on advanced technologies such as cell cultures, tissue engineering, healthcare product design, and environmental monitoring. Students also gain expertise in bioinformatics tools through a 45-day project, acquiring the skills needed to succeed in research, education (APSET, CSIR-NET), and professional job platforms.

Acquisition of lab skills in PCR, cytology, cell culture, microbial culturing, biochemical analysis, plant tissue culture, environmental monitoring, enzymology, immunological techniques, molecular and genetic engineering, and fermentation technologies.
Active participation in 15 guest lectures, cancer and diabetes awareness programmes, and 2 workshops.
Presentation of papers at national and international conferences, volunteering for events such as ESMEB-19 National Seminar and webinars (CHOBiCP 2020, WDD-2020, WED-2021).
Collaboration with the placement cell leading to jobs in CoViD labs, QC labs (Pfizer, Shanta Biotech, MSN Pharma), Bio-Pharma, and Chaitanya Techno School.
Development of eco-friendly bioproducts through an add-on certificate programme.

Alumni of the department have secured positions in prestigious organisations such as the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB), the National Institute of Nutrition (NIN), Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories, the National Institute of Virology (NIV), and the National Centre for Cell Science (NCCS), Pune. Several alumni are also pursuing successful research careers at these and other leading institutions.

The department offers a one-month training and certification programme in the fourth semester, covering mushroom cultivation, bioplastic production, and agricultural waste management, including biogas production, vermicomposting, flower waste management, incense stick preparation, and organic insect repellent preparation. These programmes complement the regular curriculum, providing students with practical, hands-on experience in key areas.

The Postgraduate Department of Chemistry was established in 2003 with a specialisation in Organic Chemistry. In 2005, an additional programme with a specialisation in Analytical Chemistry was introduced. The department comprises nine faculty members: four specialising in Organic Chemistry, three in Analytical Chemistry, one in Inorganic Chemistry, and one in Physical Chemistry.

The curriculum for the first year includes a common core of four theory papers and three practical papers for each semester. In the second year, students specialise and undertake four theory papers and two practical papers each semester.
Student Intake: 39 (33 through convener quota, 6 through management quota)
Admission Criteria: Any science graduate with a qualifying rank in APPGCET (Andhra Pradesh Postgraduate Common Entrance Test) is eligible for this course.
Programme Pattern: 4 semesters (16 theory papers, 10 lab exams). Viva Voce is mandatory in the final semester for 50 marks.
An M. Sc. Chemistry graduate has the potential to build a successful career in various sectors, including:
Research and Development: Synthetic Lab Scientist, Research Officer (Chemistry/Biochemistry), Research Scientist
Analytical and Quality Control: Application Specialist – Analytical Chemistry, Quality Control Chemist, Quality Assurance Officer
Industry Roles: Chemist, Production Supervisor, Quality Control Inspector, Research Manager
Government Positions: Chemist, Assistant Professor, Senior Research Associate, Lab Technologist, Research Engineer, Warehouse Supervisor

Graduates can also pursue research and post-research opportunities in Organic Chemistry. The department has a strong track record of preparing students for industry placements in esteemed pharmaceutical companies such as Dr Reddy’s Laboratories, Aurobindo Pharma Ltd, and Vimta Labs. Many alumni have been employed as scientists, while others have successfully pursued teaching careers in government schools and colleges.
To provide quality education to the students and to prepare them competent enough to rise up to the expectations of the global market and its changing trends.
To train the students in all aspects of Chemistry and make them competent by encouraging their participation in projects and programs organized by reputed firms for increased opportunities.

Laboratories: The department boasts five spacious, well-equipped laboratories featuring advanced instruments such as UV spectrophotometers, UV-VIS spectrophotometers, flame photometers, dissolved oxygen meters, potentiometers, and conductometers. Students conduct experiments under the close supervision of faculty and two experienced laboratory assistants, with a strong emphasis on safety to prevent accidents.
Library: The PG College Library, located on the first floor of Block 6, is well-stocked with books covering various branches of Chemistry and is open from 9 am to 4 pm.

Seminar Hall: The seminar hall, located on the first floor, is equipped with modern audio-visual technology, LCD projectors, and comfortable seating. It is utilised for digital classes, seminars, workshops, and presentations, enhancing the learning experience.
Analytical Chemistry Specialisation — Semesters III & IV
Guest Lectures: The department frequently invites eminent professors and industrialists to deliver motivational lectures for students.

Faculty Development: Staff members are encouraged and financially supported by the management to attend and present papers at seminars organised by Andhra University and other affiliated institutions.

Internships and Projects: Students are encouraged to participate in internships and projects at leading companies during Christmas and summer vacations. This hands-on experience not only enhances their practical skills but also strengthens their CVs.
CSIR NET Preparation : Students are trained and guided to prepare for the CSIR NET exams, enabling them to pursue further research and academic opportunities.

Students from the 2018–2020 cohort had the opportunity to attend a three-day training programme at GSI Hyderabad from 6th to 8th January 2020. Senior chemists from GSI shared insights into Atomic Absorption Spectroscopy, ICP-MS, and XRF. This programme introduced students to a wide range of career opportunities in both the public and private sectors. Senior chemists, Mr PVVR Sharma and Dr S Bhargav provided in-depth knowledge of instrumentation and related career paths. The training was supervised by department mentors Mrs V Subbalakshmi, Dr D Mallika, and Mrs S Gayatri.
A report on 2 day Workshop on Thin layer chromato graphy
A Report on visit to Vizag Expo
Lecture on Wealth out of waste
Report on a talk on funding opportunities for extramural research and development
Organic Reaction Mechanism, Exam: 29 September 2019, Score: 67.1
Chemical Applications of Symmetry and Group Theory, 8 weeks, Exam Date: 29 March 2020
Carbenes & Nitrenes, 4 weeks, Exam Date: 29 March 2020
Reagents in Organic Synthesis and Mechanisms in Organic Chemistry, 8 weeks, Exam Date: December 2020
Photochemistry & Pericyclic Reactions, 8 weeks, Exam Date: December 2020
Bioinorganic Chemistry, 4 weeks, Exam Date: 21 March 2021
Bioinorganic Chemistry, 4 weeks, Exam Date: 21 March 2021

Studies in Literature open a world of inspiration and creativity. As a global language, English enhances the value of individuals who master it. Throughout their schooling and undergraduate education, students explore how literature offers insight into the world through stories, poems, novels, and plays. At the postgraduate level, students of English Language and Literature sharpen their ability to write, read, analyse, and persuade. They engage in advanced studies of literature, cultivating skills in interpretation, critical reasoning, creativity, and writing. The programme consolidates the rich literary traditions from across the globe.

Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College introduced its PG programme in English Literature in 1999. The department fosters an intellectual community that equips students with excellent employability skills through a combination of literary study and skill development initiatives. The department takes pride in its faculty and students, who are highly regarded in the fields of education and research.
Student Intake: 40 through convener quota and 8 through management quota
Admission Criteria: Any graduate with a qualifying rank in APPGCET (Andhra Pradesh Postgraduate Common Entrance Test)

Programme Pattern: 4 semesters, each with 5 theory papers. The 4th semester includes a viva voce examination and project submission. Students must complete a two-credit MOOC course in the 3rd and 4th semesters. Assessment is based on 30% internal evaluation and 70% external evaluation.

Graduates in English Language and Literature have diverse career opportunities. Teaching English at various levels is the most popular choice. Other career options include media reporting, content writing, linguistic consultancy, translation, and research in language and literature.
To mould the young minds towards holistic development and to ensure the establishment of a just and humane society.
To impart knowledge and need-based education to meet global competition and to face the challenges of life.

The department combines both traditional and modern pedagogical approaches, focusing on student-centred learning and value-based education. Communication skills, interpersonal abilities, team-building, competitive spirit, and life skills are developed through various departmental activities. Faculty and students are encouraged to actively participate in seminars and workshops held at Andhra University and other institutions.
The students of the department consistently secure positions among the top ten ranks in the university, reflecting the department's academic excellence.

The Department of Master of Human Resource Management (MHRM) was established in 2008. It offers a two-year full-time postgraduate programme in Human Resource Management, preparing men and women for managerial and administrative roles across various sectors. The course is designed to cultivate an understanding of the responsibilities of an HR manager in a dynamic business environment, both nationally and globally. The programme focuses on shaping solution-oriented thinkers, competent managers, and empathetic leaders, instilling a spirit of continuous learning and innovation.
Student Intake: 40 through convener quota and 4 through management quota
Eligibility Criteria: Any graduate with a qualifying rank in AP PGCET
Programme Pattern: 4 semesters, each comprising 7 theory subjects, 1 fieldwork component, and 1 viva voce examination

Graduates of the MHRM programme have a wide range of career opportunities in sectors such as corporate management, industrial relations, talent acquisition, and HR consultancy. The programme prepares students for roles such as:

Graduates are well-positioned for employment in diverse industries, including manufacturing, IT, healthcare, banking, and education. Many also pursue careers in public sector organisations, government agencies, and non-profit entities. The programme also equips students with the skills necessary for research and further academic pursuits in Human Resource Management.
To strive for producing quality business leaders in Human Resource Management with human touch and values
To prepare specialist HR Managers with practical orientation
To have a holistic approach to personality building

The department employs participative and collaborative teaching methods, encouraging active student engagement. In addition to traditional classroom instruction, the department organises seminars, workshops, and guest lectures by esteemed professionals and academicians. Regular personality development sessions and personalised counselling are also provided. Students are encouraged to participate in PowerPoint presentations, workshops, paper presentations, seminars, debates, and case studies to enhance their practical understanding of HRM.

Fieldwork is an integral component of the curriculum, helping bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application. It equips students with the skills needed by industry professionals, with guidance and support provided throughout the fieldwork activity.

The department is equipped with well-furnished classrooms and staff rooms, along with round-the-clock internet access. A modern, well-stocked library enhances the students' learning experience. The department also utilises contemporary computer lab equipment and multimedia tools to conduct interactive and developmental sessions.
Students are encouraged to utilise technology, including LCDs and projectors, and assist other departments with data processing and management tasks. Key initiatives include:
Online Student Feedback System: This software facilitates the collection of feedback on faculty, infrastructure, and facilities, making the process efficient and streamlined.
Student Fee Tracking System: This software automates student fee payment tracking, assisting the administrative department in managing finances more effectively.
Online Student Data Bank System: This system simplifies the storage and retrieval of student personal information as needed.

The Department of Microbiology, located in the PG Block of Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College, was established in 2001. The department was founded with the vision of empowering students to secure strong positions in research, post-research studies, and high-profile roles in their desired industries. It is proud of its commitment to quality education and its consistent success rate in student qualifications.

Microbiology, as a field, focuses on the study of microorganisms and their significant role in maintaining both human health and environmental balance. Microbial activities are diverse and are vital for sustaining ecosystems. With the rapid advancements and expanding applications of microbiology in human and environmental sustainability, the curriculum, designed by Andhra University, aims to equip students with expertise in the core areas of the subject. The MSc Microbiology course is spread over four semesters across two years, with each semester including four theory papers and two practical papers, each carrying four credits. Additionally, the fourth semester includes mandatory project work, also worth four credits, and a comprehensive viva voce at the end of each semester.
The department also operates a Research Centre, sanctioned by Andhra University, which offers both Master of Philosophy (MPhil) and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) programmes in Microbiology.
Eligibility Criteria: Any Science graduate with a qualifying rank in the APPGCET
Eligibility Criteria: MSc Microbiology graduate with a qualifying rank in the Common Research Entrance Test (R-CET)
Eligibility Criteria: MSc or MPhil in Microbiology with a qualifying rank in the Common Research Entrance Test (R-CET)

By the end of the two-year MSc programme, students acquire extensive hands-on experience through experimental work. The department emphasises the importance of microorganisms in both natural ecosystems and human welfare, covering a wide range of specialised fields. Graduates can pursue employment in diverse industries, including the food industry, pharmaceuticals, medical and research laboratories, aquaculture, waste disposal, and more. The unique nature of the course enables students to secure rewarding roles, with prospects for high salaries, incentives, and job security. Additionally, research and post-research opportunities are available for those who wish to continue their studies in microbiology.
To attain new heights in Microbiology research, shaping it as a career and to focus on the importance of the microbial world in nature for human welfare.
To impart knowledge in the field of Microbiology and to train the students with hands-on practical experience so that they can fit themselves in research field.

The department integrates modern teaching methodologies, including animation films and PowerPoint presentations delivered through LCD projectors. Students and faculty are actively encouraged to participate in national seminars and workshops to foster a spirit of learning and teaching. Bridge classes and remedial sessions are offered to further support student development. Faculty members also provide coaching for students aspiring to qualify for CSIR NET, APSET, and GATE examinations.

The department is equipped with well-established laboratories featuring advanced equipment, creating an optimal learning environment for students. Laboratory sessions are conducted under the supervision of faculty and skilled lab technicians. In addition, the department has a designated space in the PG Library for its extensive collection of subject-related books, providing students with a comfortable place to study. Air-conditioned seminar halls are available for hosting seminars, workshops, guest lectures, and PowerPoint presentations.

The Department of Microbiology was further strengthened with the establishment of a research centre, sanctioned by Andhra University in 2007. Both the Head of Department and one other faculty member are eligible to supervise PhD and MPhil programmes.
Horticultural Training: Final-year students receive training organised by the Department of Horticulture, Visakhapatnam, Government of Andhra Pradesh.
Industrial Visits: Students participate in short tours to various production and processing units of small-scale industries in and around Visakhapatnam.
Add-On Programmes: The department runs multiple add-on programmes aimed at providing students with all-round skill development.

The Master of Commerce (M. Com.) is a highly sought-after, career-oriented professional programme offered at the postgraduate level. Established in 2018 and affiliated with Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, this two-year course provides in-depth knowledge of key functional areas of commerce, including economics, capital, revenue, trade, taxes, market demands, and opportunities. It also introduces advanced topics in multinational commerce, accounting, finance, marketing, and project management.
Admission Criteria: A degree in commerce and a qualifying rank in APPGCET (Andhra Pradesh Postgraduate Common Entrance Test)

Graduates of the M. Com. programme have a broad range of career opportunities across various sectors. The rigorous training provided in accounting, taxation, banking, and finance equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to pursue roles in corporate management, financial services, and consulting firms. Graduates may find positions as financial analysts, accountants, auditors, tax consultants, banking professionals, or investment advisors. The entrepreneurial skills imparted through the programme also provide a solid foundation for those seeking to start their own businesses. Additionally, the programme prepares graduates for academic and research careers, providing them with a pathway to further studies or roles in education.

The department fosters strong teacher-student relationships to create an enhanced learning environment. Regular seminars, workshops, and guest lectures by industry professionals are organised to provide students with exposure to real-world business practices. Teaching methodologies include case studies, role plays, presentations, discussions, debates, and activities focused on current affairs. Alongside coursework, students receive training in skills development, including soft skills, communication skills, analytical skills, Tally, GST, and various online examinations. The programme also integrates activities designed to cultivate leadership and problem-solving abilities.
1. Intensive Curriculum: Bridging the gap between theory and practice
2. Electives: Specialisations in accounting, taxation, and banking finance
3. Current Affairs, Journal Club, and Activity Hours
To provide systematic and rigorous training in banking and accountancy-related disciplines.
To develop students' conceptual, applied, and research skills for effective problem-solving and decision-making in both routine and specialised activities.
To enable graduates to apply frameworks and tools for informed decision-making in professional settings.
To empower students to make positive contributions to commerce, trade, and industry, particularly within a national context.
To support graduates with entrepreneurial aspirations in initiating and building their own ventures.

The Journal Club is a vibrant hub of activities that helps students stay informed about current global trends and pressing issues. Every alternate week, discussions, debates, presentations, and workshops are conducted, allowing students to develop confidence, assertiveness, and the ability to articulate ideas clearly and effectively.

Periodic industrial visits, organised under the guidance of facilitators, help students gain practical insights into the operations of various companies. Industries visited include renowned organisations such as BHEL, Visakha Steel Plant, and Visakhapatnam Port Trust, providing students with a clear understanding of the functionality and processes of these entities.
The Career Guidance & Placement Cell (CG & PC) was established in 2010 with the objective of providing career guidance and facilitating placements across various industry verticals nationwide.

The CG & PC is efficiently structured with Mr. Y.M.V. Prasad serving as the Assistant Dean of Placements and Mr. V.V. Raja Rao handling Public & Corporate Relations for the campus. Together, they work to achieve the diverse objectives set by the CG & PC.

Working in close tandem with the Skill Development Centre, the CG & PC provides comprehensive career solutions to students. The Postgraduate Library at Dr. Lankapalli Bullayya College offers a vast collection of resources tailored to the needs of advanced learners across a variety of disciplines. Our well-curated library serves students and faculty from various departments.

Equipped with textbooks, reference materials, academic journals, and digital resources, the library fosters a dynamic learning environment that supports research, coursework, and personal academic growth. With dedicated sections for each subject area, students can access the latest publications in their respective fields, along with comprehensive study materials.

The library also features study areas for students to conduct research, and work on projects and assignments. Our goal is to support postgraduate students in achieving academic excellence and fostering a culture of research and inquiry.
